items.reason: Carried the mode in Witness.Values: new internal _mode (nil for Values()), set to the context's mode whenever values are read through Witness.Context (current, subscripts, Escaped/Access/Scope captures), kept by merging. The Witness.Key getter resolves with _mode ?? .live. The Witness.Key.Test getter now honours preview (_mode == .preview ? .preview : .test) but deliberately keeps .test for live, because resolving a Test-only key in .live hits Witness.Diagnostics.testDefaultServedInLive, which is fatalError in DEBUG and would newly trap @WitnessAccessors reads in tests that run in the default .live context mode. Test: 'Values read through current respect test mode'.

Took the 'pin it with a test' option plus a /// doc comment on the overload (no rename, to avoid an API break). A scope cannot hold a nonescapable value, so overrides only exist for escapable values; the visible hazard is generic code over K.Value: ~Escapable reaching this overload and missing an override. The test calls it through a generic helper constrained to a nested ~Copyable & ~Escapable protocol and pins that it returns the default (1) while the escapable overload returns the override (42).

items.item: prepareDependencies values are never consulted by resolution (no checklist; whole issue)
items.reason: Witness.Context._current now attaches the active Witness.Preparation.store (task-local, set by Witness.Preparation.with, which prepareDependencies(_:operation:) calls) as the values' _preparedRef, so Witness.Context[K], Witness.Context.current[K] and therefore @Dependency (swift-dependencies Dependency.Values reads Witness.Context[key]) resolve prepared values inside the operation. Precedence: scope override > prepared value > mode default. Tests: 'A prepared value resolves through the context' and 'A scoped override wins over a prepared value' in Witness.Context Tests.swift. A test through @Dependency itself would belong in swift-compositions/swift-dependencies (Tests/Dependencies Tests/prepareDependencies Tests.swift), not edited here.

api_changes: No public signature changes. Behaviour: Witness.Context.current[K] (and the @WitnessAccessors static methods built on it) now resolve in the context's mode instead of always live; Witness.Key.Test keys read that way honour preview mode. Prepared values now resolve through Witness.Context.
dependents: swift-compositions/swift-dependencies: Sources/Dependencies/Dependency.Context.swift:17 (__DependencyContext.current merges root.values with Witness.Context.current; merging keeps the scoped _mode), Sources/Dependencies/Dependency.Values.swift:29,39 (reads Witness.Context[key]; now sees prepared values), Sources/Dependencies/prepareDependencies.swift:6,14 (Witness.Preparation.with path now effective).
notes: The new internal stored property Witness.Values._mode is @usableFromInline and initialized in the @inlinable init(). Behaviour change to watch in the ecosystem build/tests: code reading Witness.Context.current[K] inside withTest/withPreview now gets test/preview values (previously live).
